name: aluisiopulga/content_assistant
description: Lets AI assistants search, list, count and draft Drupal content through safe, permission-checked tools (Tool API, MCP and the Drupal AI module).

suggest.drupal/mcp_server: Exposes the tools to Claude and other MCP clients (with drupal/mcp_server_tool_bridge).
suggest.drupal/mcp_server_tool_bridge: Bridges the Tool API tools into MCP Server.
suggest.drupal/ai: Lets Drupal AI chatbots and agents use the tools (with the Tool module's AI Connector submodule).
